# Cavin Macwan

> Cavin Macwan is a developer and co-founder of Meticha. He builds thoughtful iOS and Android apps, open-source tools, and digital products.

This portfolio features selected work and articles on software development. Contact: cavin@meticha.com.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://cavinmacwan.com/): About Cavin, his approach to building products, and selected work.
- [Articles](https://cavinmacwan.com/articles): Technical writing by Cavin.

## Selected work

- [Oren](https://www.getoren.app/): A reading companion for building a reading habit.
- [Permissions Compose](https://github.com/meticha/permissions-compose): An Android library for permission handling in Jetpack Compose.

## Articles

- [Why Kotlin uses Coroutines](https://cavinmacwan.com/articles/why-kotlin-uses-coroutines): The design choices behind Kotlin coroutines and structured concurrency.
- [Master Permission Handling in Jetpack Compose](https://cavinmacwan.com/articles/master-permission-handling-in-jetpack-compose): A practical approach to Android runtime permissions in Compose.
